facts.text: Villa Igiea was built in 1900, at the height of the Belle Epoque.
facts.excerpt: Built in 1900 at the height of the Belle Époque, Villa Igiea was transformed by the Florio family

facts.text: The Florio family turned Villa Igiea from a private palazzo into a hotel.
facts.excerpt: Villa Igiea was transformed by the Florio family from a private palazzo into one of Sicily's most refined hotels

facts.text: The palazzo sits at the edge of Palermo, at the foot of Mount Pellegrino on the Gulf of Palermo.
facts.excerpt: a turn-of-the-century palazzo at the perimeter of vivid Palermo, the foot of Mount Pellegrino and the Gulf of Palermo

facts.text: Florio Restaurant is set in the villa's historic Louis XVI hall.
facts.excerpt: where the Florios' most distinguished guests once dined in this historic Louis XVI hall

facts.text: The Florio Restaurant menu is designed by Chef Fulvio Pierangelini.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Chef Fulvio Pierangelini, the menu reflects a philosophy of simplicity, generosity and ultimate quality

facts.text: Alicetta is a bistro on terraces between the garden and the sea.
facts.excerpt: Perched on terraces that float between the magnificent garden and the sea, Alicetta offers an enchanting view and it becomes a bona fide bistro.

facts.text: Alicetta is enclosed in a metal pavilion modelled on the pavilion of the Palazzo Butera.
facts.excerpt: Alicetta is enclosed in a pretty metal pavilion modelled on the same design as the pavilion of the Palazzo Butera.

facts.text: Igiea Terrazza Bar overlooks the Gulf of Palermo and is set among 1950s frescoes.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the shimmering Gulf of Palermo, Igiea Terrazza Bar is where elegance, heritage and Mediterranean light come together. Set among 1950s frescoes

facts.text: The bar's aperitivo hour takes place in the villa's sandstone vaults, with a wide selection of Florio liqueurs.
facts.excerpt: Discover the true meaning of aperitivo hour in Villa Igiea's elegant sandstone vaults, and uncover the widest selection of Florio liqueurs.

facts.text: On Fridays the Igiea Terrazza Bar has live music, with cocktails by Maestro Salvatore Calabrese.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy live performances from talented artists every Friday, with cocktails by Maestro Salvatore Calabrese and dance under the stars.

facts.text: The George V Suite is named after King George V, who stayed at the villa during his 1925 visit to Sicily.
facts.excerpt: named after King George V, who took residence here during his visit to Sicily in 1925.

facts.text: The Donna Franca Suite has a separate living room and a sea-view terrace with lounges and sunbeds.
facts.excerpt: with a separate living room and the added luxury of a breezy sea-view terrace, outfitted with lounges and sunbeds

facts.text: The Tower Suites are in the palazzo's tower and have several balconies overlooking the gardens.
facts.excerpt: With generous spaces and several balconies to admire the gardens from the iconic tower of our fabled palazzo

facts.text: The Family Room is made up of two interconnecting Deluxe rooms.
facts.excerpt: comprising two spacious, interconnecting Deluxe rooms

facts.text: Florio serves a Sunday brunch of traditional Italian dishes with live music on its terrace, every Sunday from mid October.
facts.excerpt: Every Sunday from mid October Gather friends and family for a feast of traditional Italian dishes, with live music and stunning views of the Azure Tyrrhenian Sea on our sunny terrace.

facts.text: Florio restaurant and the bars require smart casual dress after 7.30pm.
facts.excerpt: our Restaurant & Bars require a smart casual dress code after 7.30pm

facts.text: Igiea Terrazza Bar does not operate a dress code.
facts.excerpt: whilst we do not operate a dress code, we kindly recommend that our guests are respectful

facts.text: The hotel offers boat trips along the Mondello coast that include the Capo Gallo Nature Reserve.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a relaxing boat trip along Mondello's stunning coast. Swim in turquoise waters, explore hidden coves, and discover Capo Gallo Nature Reserve.

facts.text: The hotel's curated experiences include wine tastings and hands-on cooking classes.
facts.excerpt: surrender to the flavours of Sicily with intimate wine tastings and hands-on cooking classes

facts.text: A tour by Ape Calessino, Palermo's tuk-tuk, explores the city with a private guide.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a journey aboard Palermo's famous tuk-tuk, the Ape Calessino, exploring baroque streets, markets and Arab-Norman treasures with a private guide.

facts.text: Rocco Forte took over Villa Igiea in 2019.
facts.excerpt: The hotelier took it over in 2019 and opened it two years later

facts.text: The villa was used as a film backdrop by de Sica and Sordi.
facts.excerpt: It then became a cinematic backdrop, used by de Sica and Sordi.

facts.text: The rooms reflect the design of Olga Polizzi, Rocco Forte's sister.
facts.excerpt: The rooms are where you will feel the modern touch of Olga Polizzi, Rocco's sister and his portfolio's top designer, the most.

facts.text: The Irene Forte spa uses Irene Forte skincare, made with botanicals from the Verdura Resort farm.
facts.excerpt: The Irene Forte spa features the eponymous skincare line that Irene, one of Rocco's two daughters, has created using botanicals from the family's Verdura Resort's farm

facts.text: The hotel is on the coast, about a 15-minute drive from central Palermo.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is located along the coast, about a 15-minute drive from central Palermo, which you can see across the bay.

facts.text: A private boat can take guests between the hotel and the city.
facts.excerpt: A private boat can ferry guests to and from the city and resort.

facts.text: The hotel has a pool and tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: With its pool and tennis courts, this place is comfortable for families.

facts.text: The neighborhood around the hotel is suburban.
facts.excerpt: The neighborhood around the resort is suburban

contradictions.note: p4 says the restaurant and bars require smart casual dress after 7.30pm; p5 says Igiea Terrazza Bar does not operate a dress code
